mapper.select: SELECT * FROM kb_knowledge_base WHERE create_user = #{userId} OR visibility = 'PUBLIC' ORDER BY create_time DESC
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO kb_knowledge_base (name, description, create_user, visibility, chunk_size, chunk_overlap, top_k, similarity_threshold, vector_weight, keyword_weight, heading_split_enabled, table_keep_strategy, create_time) VALUES (#{name}, #{description}, #{createUser}, #{visibility}, #{chunkSize}, #{chunkOverlap}, #{topK}, #{similarityThreshold}, #{vectorWeight}, #{keywordWeight}, #{headingSplitEnabled}, #{tableKeepStrategy}, NOW())
mapper.update: UPDATE kb_knowledge_base SET name = #{name}, description = #{description}, visibility = #{visibility}, chunk_size = #{chunkSize}, chunk_overlap = #{chunkOverlap}, top_k = #{topK}, similarity_threshold = #{similarityThreshold}, vector_weight = #{vectorWeight}, keyword_weight = #{keywordWeight}, heading_split_enabled = #{headingSplitEnabled}, table_keep_strategy = #{tableKeepStrategy} WHERE id = #{id}
mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM kb_file WHERE kb_id = #{kbId} AND (is_current = 1 OR is_current IS NULL)
SELECT COALESCE(SUM(file_size), 0) FROM kb_file WHERE kb_id = #{kbId} AND (is_current = 1 OR is_current IS NULL)
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM kb_chunk c INNER JOIN kb_file f ON f.id = c.file_id WHERE f.kb_id = #{kbId} AND (f.is_current = 1 OR f.is_current IS NULL)
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM kb_file WHERE kb_id = #{kbId} AND (is_current = 1 OR is_current IS NULL) AND vector_status = 'READY'
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM kb_file WHERE kb_id = #{kbId} AND (is_current = 1 OR is_current IS NULL) AND status = 'FAILED'

SELECT COALESCE(SUM(duplicate_count), 0) FROM ( SELECT file_sha256, COUNT(*) - 1 AS duplicate_count FROM kb_file WHERE kb_id = #{kbId} AND file_sha256 IS NOT NULL GROUP BY file_sha256 HAVING COUNT(*) > 1 ) duplicate_files

SELECT COUNT(*) FROM kb_chunk c INNER JOIN kb_file f ON f.id = c.file_id WHERE f.kb_id = #{kbId} AND (f.is_current = 1 OR f.is_current IS NULL) AND (c.content IS NULL OR CHAR_LENGTH(TRIM(c.content)) < 30)

SELECT f.id, f.file_name AS fileName, COUNT(c.id) AS chunkCount FROM kb_file f LEFT JOIN kb_chunk c ON c.file_id = f.id WHERE f.kb_id = #{kbId} AND (f.is_current = 1 OR f.is_current IS NULL) GROUP BY f.id, f.file_name ORDER BY chunkCount DESC LIMIT #{limit}
